item.anchor.thermometer.use: Use it on a block or in the air to read the temperature
item.anchor.thermometer.sneak: Sneak and use it on a block to record it over time
message.anchor.thermometer.waiting: No reading yet: this area is still being loaded into the simulation
item.anchor.thermal_camera.use: Use it to switch between surfaces and air
item.anchor.thermal_camera.sneak: Sneak and use it to lock the scale
message.anchor.thermal_camera.nothing: Nothing in view is simulated yet
message.anchor.probe.full: A dimension holds at most %s probes; remove one with /anchor probe remove
message.anchor.probe.bad_name: Probe names are letters, digits, _ and -, at most %s of them
message.anchor.laboratory.air: The air here stays at %s and %s humidity, the sun gives no heat, and nothing spawns or grows, so only your experiments change what you build.
message.anchor.laboratory.instruments: Use the thermometer on a block to read it, or sneak and use it to record it; hold the thermal camera to see heat.
message.anchor.laboratory.commands: %s pauses, steps and speeds up heat, and %s saves an experiment so that you can run it again.
